subject: Request: One-off make-good + access-tier price carveout for Helios Labs
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen@helioslabs.com>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@helioslabs.com
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 15:24:00 -0400
Subject: Access tier ask and onboarding protection

Hi Rohan,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the dedicated capacity + private control plane is exactly what our platform team wanted to see. Procurement asked me to send over a specific ask so we can close the commercials this month. High level:

- 12-month committed spend (we expect heavy usage months in Q4).
- Access Tier to include VPC private deployment + reserved GPUs for predictable latency.
- Onboarding safeguard: a one-off "make-good" credit if our initial usage falls below 60% of the committed baseline in the first 90 days (we need protection while we finish model tuning).

We understand the request is atypical but would consider a 12-month firm if we get a modest make-good and a stepped onboarding credit. Can you confirm if Redwood can entertain a 25% onboarding credit and a capped make-good for the first quarter?

Attached is our internal usage projection. Happy to hop on a short call to walk through.

Best,
Ellen
Ellen Park
Director, Platform Engineering
Helios Labs

Attachment: helio-usage-modeling-sep2026.xlsx (spreadsheet, 92 KB)

From: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
To: Ellen Park <ellen@helioslabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Access tier ask and onboarding protection

Hi Ellen —

Appreciate the clarity and the model (helpful). We can support the Access Tier (VPC + reserved pool) and a structured onboarding credit, but this ask touches our commercial guardrails. Two items that need internal signoff:

1) One-off make-good: request is for ~25% of committed spend back if usage <60% in first 90 days — this exceeds standard onboarding credits for Dedicated.
2) Upfront discounts / credits: a 25% onboarding credit plus a make-good would materially change our unit economics for the pilot.

I’m looping in Marissa (revenue ops) and Karthik (pricing) to get a path to executive signoff. Would you be open to a compromise: 15% onboarding credit + a capped make-good equal to 20% of committed spend (only triggered if usage <50% in q1)? If Helios can accept a phased ramp (month-by-month minimums for months 2–4) it makes the ask more palatable.

If that compromise isn’t acceptable, I’ll escalate for VP/CFO signoff — we move quickly on approvals when there is a strategic fit.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Sr. Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposal-Helios-Access-Tier-v2.pdf (proposal, 1.1 MB)

From: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: INTERNAL: Helios Labs — pricing exception request (need VP/CFO signoff?)

Team —

Quick ask: Helios (prospect -> likely close) has asked for: 12m commitment + 25% onboarding credit + a one-off make-good if usage <60% first 90 days. I proposed a compromise (15% onboarding + capped make-good = 20% of committed spend triggered only if usage <50% q1) but Helios indicated they prefer the original ask.

Why this matters: Helios is a strategic target in cloud genomics (strong reference value, potential multi-region expansion). If we push back too hard we risk losing momentum and Pax (their CTO) wants the pilot to start in Oct.

Financial ask: I’m requesting an exception to the standard onboarding/credit guardrails. Specifically:
- Approve up to 20% one-off make-good (not to exceed $120k) OR
- Approve a blended concession: 15% onboarding credit + a 10% capped make-good (total economic impact <= $95k)

Notes: deal_id HL-2026-1123. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/987654/deal/HL-2026-1123. Docs attached.

Please respond with: Approve / Approve with modification (please state) / Decline. If you want me to route to VP/CFO with a short memo I can prepare. Need response by EOD today to keep the Oct kickoff timeline.

Thanks,
Rohan

---
Proposal attached. Use of the capped numbers above assumes 12-month committed revenue of $600k (model attached).

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Helios Labs — pricing exception request (need VP/CFO signoff?)

Thanks for the context, Rohan. Quick read:
- Strategic importance: agree Helios is high-signal.
- Economics: 25% onboarding + full make-good exposure crosses our threshold for AE-level approvals.
- Risk mitigation: prefer your blended concession but recommend tightening the trigger window and capping per-month exposure.

My recommendation (to shorten the path to VP/CFO):
- Offer 15% onboarding credit up front.
- Make-good only if usage <45% in first 60 days (not 90).
- Cap total make-good to $75k and allow rollback to list pricing after month 3 if ramp metrics are not met.

If Marissa and Mina are okay, I’ll consolidate this into a one-page exec memo and propose we request VP signoff (Marissa to route to CFO if needed).

-Karthik

Sent from my mobile — tell me if you want tighter numbers and I can run a sensitivity fast.

From: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Helios Labs — pricing exception request (need VP/CFO signoff?)

Marissa / Mina —

Karthik's recommendation looks good and narrows the exposure. Please approve IAW below so I can reply to Ellen with a firm offer and DocuSign link:

- 15% onboarding credit (applied in month 1 billing).
- Conditional make-good: triggered only if average daily usage <45% of committed baseline in first 60 days.
- Cap make-good at $75,000 total; credit applied as billing adjustment in month 3.
- If ramp metrics not met by end of month 3, Redwood can revert to standard list rates for any additional capacity.

Approve / Approve with modification (state) / Decline.

If you approve, I’ll send the terms to Ellen and attach a short exec summary for the VP/CFO record.

Thanks — Rohan
